title: world3 orchestrator capture request
description: JSON consumed by OrchestratorCaptureDriver.gd via user://orchestrator_capture_request.json. The Python wrapper run_orchestrator_capture.py writes this file before invoking Godot. Schema retrofitted 2026-05-11 (E.8 backfill) for LLM-drivability parity with the region_request/world_plan/style_pack schemas.

bundle_dir.description: res:// path to the bundle directory (must contain heightmap.png + meta.json).

material.description: res:// path to the terrain_blend .tres material. If style_pack has a material_suffix, this is rewritten by the wrapper before reaching the driver.

mode.description: Which tour-index frame to capture. Maps to MODE_TOUR_INDEX in OrchestratorCaptureDriver.gd.

output.description: res:// path for the output PNG. Parent dir must exist (the wrapper ensures this).

macro_albedo.description: Optional res:// override for the source macro albedo (e.g. layers/render_albedo.png from the bundle).

macro_mask.description: Optional res:// override for the source macro valid mask.

tour_profile.description: Which World3AutoReviewTour tour profile to instantiate. Default 'standard' covers close/medium/iso/topdown; alternate profiles exist for seam_integration etc.

warmup_frames.description: Process frames to await before saving the PNG. Higher values give chunks more time to stream and lighting more time to settle. ~60 frames at 60 fps = 1s.

viewport_size.description: Output viewport size in pixels [W, H].

start_x_m.description: Tour anchor X in meters. Drives camera framing across all 4 modes.

chunk_size_m.description: ChunkLoader chunk size for this capture. Should match the bundle's natural scale to avoid grid artifacts (see G.1 for auto-derivation work).

chunk_resolution_m.description: ChunkLoader mesh spacing within a chunk.

style.description: Inline style overrides. Normally populated by the wrapper from style_packs/<id>.json. Fields here override World3AutoReviewTour defaults; omitted fields fall back to the tour's hardcoded values. See style_pack_schema.json for the field shape.

style_pack_id.description: Identifier of the style pack the wrapper loaded from. For provenance only; the driver reads 'style' regardless.
